notes.subject: dugukolo
notes.rationale: אדמת ye adama-soil ye (dugubala jɛgɛnsira), dugukolo ye a ka surunyali ye Bamanankan na

notes.subject: cogo di na
notes.rationale: איך ye ɲininka-daɲɛ ye min bɛ bɔ a yɛrɛ kɔnɔ — kumasen in ye danbe-juguya ɲininka ye, a tɛ ɲininka tiɲɛ ye

notes.subject: min ye Yawe ta
notes.rationale: Hebrew construct שיר יהוה (bound) — Bamanankan tɛ construct jɔcogo dɔn o nɔ na, o la possessor-fra farala a kan

notes.subject: an
notes.rationale: Kumasen in bɛ wele jamana jan kɔnɔ yɔrɔ la — aw ni an ye Kudu-yɔrɔlanw ye, n'u bɛ ɲininka hɛrɛ-bɔli ko

translation: Cogo di na an bɛ lanbu ⟨את⟩ lanbu min ye Yawe ta, dugukolo jan na?
